description: This file contains implementation of UCC tracing utilities for distributed communication in PyTorch, including logging, trace flushing, and communication event recording.

classes.name: ProcessGroupUCCLogger
classes.description: Logger class for UCC communication tracing, manages initialization and flushing of trace data.

classes.name: CommTraceLogger
classes.description: Handles recording of communication events and optional info for UCC tracing.

methods.name: ProcessGroupUCCLogger::flushComms
methods.description: Flushes the collected communication trace data to a JSON file.

methods.name: CommTraceLogger::setCurBlock
methods.description: Sets the current block name for tracing (unused).

methods.name: CommTraceLogger::popBlock
methods.description: Removes the last block from the trace stack (unused).

methods.name: CommTraceLogger::recordOptionalInfo
methods.description: Records optional info such as root rank and split sizes.

methods.name: CommTraceLogger::recordComms
methods.description: Records a communication event with details like name, tensors, and rank.
